summary: Tolnaftate is an over-the-counter topical thiocarbamate antifungal effective against dermatophytes. It treats and helps prevent athlete's foot (tinea pedis) and ringworm (tinea corporis), relieving itching, scaling, cracking and redness. It is not effective for scalp or nail infections and is for external use only.
indications: Treatment of most athlete's foot (tinea pedis) and ringworm (tinea corporis)
Relief of itching, scaling, cracking, burning, redness, soreness and irritation of these conditions
Daily use helps prevent recurrence of athlete's foot

moa: Tolnaftate is a thiocarbamate that distorts the hyphae and stunts mycelial growth of dermatophyte fungi. It is believed to inhibit squalene epoxidase, an enzyme in fungal ergosterol biosynthesis, leading to accumulation of squalene and disruption of the fungal cell membrane.

preg: Systemic absorption from topical use is negligible, so risk in pregnancy is expected to be very low. Use as directed; consult a clinician for extensive or prolonged use.
lact: Topical use is considered compatible with breastfeeding given negligible systemic absorption. Avoid applying directly to the nipple/areola where the infant could ingest it.

missed: If an application is missed, apply it as soon as remembered and continue the regular schedule. Missed topical doses are not dangerous - simply resume twice-daily use.
overdose: Tolnaftate has very low systemic absorption, so topical overdose is not expected to cause systemic toxicity. If accidentally swallowed, contact a poison control center; manage supportively.
